items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lloyd Bochner, a real solid bunch of Canadian actors... John Boorman film. A lot of fun to do that movie, work

ctx.x: I’ll have to watch for that.
Lloyd Bochner, a real solid bunch of Canadian actors, John Vernon. John Boorman film. A lot of fun to do that movie, work, but fun, that’s one of the more rewarding ones.

Before we… I don't get too far ahead of ourselves chronologically although I want to get back to your specific, other films later like, The Sandpiper, and The Americanization of Emily, and The Russians are Coming, but what I wanted to do is talk about some of the vocal albums you did in the late 50s with people like David Allyn and Sinatra and Jo Stafford and Mel Tormé.
